weekend_race.race_comments: Tyler Reddick has won the DAYTONA 500 at Daytona International Speedway, his ninth victory in the NASCAR Cup Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: Nos. 1, 7, 17, 24 (backup cars).
